verdict.rationale: BVNK documents its own transaction-report capability: subscribing to the `bvnk:ledger:report:ready` webhook event delivers reconciliation reports, which is a first-party way to get ledger data out. Nothing shows it covers all account data, uses open formats, or supports offboarding. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, stated open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), coverage beyond transaction reports, offboarding/portability guidance, and independent corroboration.
